name: index
description: Index a directory's TypeScript, Python and Go files, or update the index after edits. Incremental: an update takes milliseconds. Starts language servers in the background.

path.description: Directory to index, relative to the current one. Defaults to the current directory.

name: search_symbols
description: Find indexed definitions by name or qualified name. Returns each symbol's id, kind, file and position.

query.description: Text to find in names and qualified names.

exact.description: Match the whole name instead of any part of it.

path.description: Only symbols whose file path contains this text.

name: outline
description: List the symbols defined in a file, in source order.

file.description: Path relative to the current directory.

name: references
description: Find where a symbol is used, resolved by a language server, with the function each use sits in. Unlike text search, other symbols with the same name are not reported.

symbol.description: A name (`delete`), a qualified name (`Router.delete`), or an id from search_symbols (`#415`).

path.description: Only symbols whose file path contains this text.

refresh.description: Ask the language server again instead of using a stored answer.

name: definition
description: Find where the symbol used at a position is defined, such as the function a call goes to.

file.description: Path relative to the current directory.

refresh.description: Ask the language server again instead of using a stored answer.

name: implementations
description: Find what implements an interface or interface method, or overrides a method.

symbol.description: A name (`delete`), a qualified name (`Router.delete`), or an id from search_symbols (`#415`).

path.description: Only symbols whose file path contains this text.

refresh.description: Ask the language server again instead of using a stored answer.

name: signature
description: Show a symbol's declaration as written, and the language server's description of it (inferred types and documentation).
